summary: Arrow Electronics filed an 8-K to report Amendment No. 36 to its North American accounts-receivable securitization facility, extending maturity to September 2, 2029, increasing the facility limit from $1.5 billion to $1.75 billion, and adding a step-up provision for temporary leverage relief tied to material acquisitions. Participating banks include Bank of America, PNC, Truist, Wells Fargo, Mizuho, and SMBC. No equity, merger, or special-situation transaction is involved — this is a routine credit-facility amendment reported under Items 1.01 and 2.03. What to watch: terms may facilitate future acquisitions, but no deal is pending or disclosed.
